items.text: Today, as I worked on my dissertation involving complex algorithms, a peculiar Indian cockroach scurried across my desk. It was fascinating to observe its movements, almost like it knew something important. Suddenly, a message popped up from the Veteran Nigerian Nollywood community, inviting me for an interview. They seemed excited about the idea of collaborating with someone who combines academic rigor with a unique flair. Now I had to remember to mention tuition when they asked about my fees.
